Parse Diplomacy order notation

Source: R/order-parse.R
dp_parse_orders.Rd

Reads orders written in standard notation and returns them as a dp_orders tibble. All the usual spellings are accepted, in any case:

Usage

dp_parse_orders(
  x,
  power = NULL,
  phase = c("movement", "retreat", "build"),
  map = dp_map(),
  call = rlang::caller_env()
)

Arguments

x

A character vector of orders, one per element. Multi-line strings are split on newlines and semicolons.

power

Default power for orders that do not name one.

phase

Phase the orders belong to: "movement", "retreat" or "build". A bare "A Tri - Alb" is a move in a movement phase and a retreat in a retreat phase.

map

A dp_map object used to validate province codes.

call

Caller environment, for error reporting. Experts only.

Value

A dp_orders tibble with one row per order.

Details

  • "A Par - Bur", "A Par-Bur", "A Paris to Burgundy" (move)

  • "A Bur H", "A Bur holds" (hold)

  • "F Lon S A Wal - Yor", "F Lon supports A Wal" (support)

  • "F Nth C A Lon - Nwy" (convoy)

  • "A Lon - Bel via convoy" (explicitly convoyed move)

  • "A Tri R Alb" (retreat), "Build A Par", "Remove F Bre", "Waive"

Each element may be prefixed with the ordering power, as in "France: A Par - Bur". Otherwise power supplies it.

See also

Other orders: as_tibble.dp_orders(), dp_bind_orders(), dp_example_orders(), dp_legal_orders(), dp_order(), dp_orders, format.dp_orders(), is_dp_orders()

Examples

dp_parse_orders(c("France: A Par - Bur", "France: A Mar S A Par - Bur"))
#> <dp_orders> (2 orders)
#> France: A Par - Bur
#> France: A Mar S A Par - Bur
dp_parse_orders("F Nth C A Lon - Nwy", power = "England")
#> <dp_orders> (1 order)
#> England: F Nth C A Lon - Nwy
